invalid_record_policy: An execution-invalid episode is neither task false nor goal false. First valid fixed-policy replay is accepted regardless of success. Valid budget/model failures remain.

excluded_configurations.reason: Literal returned model label remains outside the frozen allowed set.
The fixed original model route did not produce a valid execution within the retry policy.

scope_of_exclusion: Whole configurations, not task-level denominators. Valid results from excluded configurations are retained for audit but not ranked.

adjudication: Explicit model-blinded Codex-assisted semantic review, not human annotation or independent-model-family validation.
